title: 动感雕塑
prompt: A kinetic sculpture of a [subject], made of interlocking metal rods and panels in brushed [color1] and oxidized [color2]. Suspended in motion, with rotating parts casting mechanical shadows on a concrete pedestal.
description: 借助 Nano Banana Pro 打造动感雕塑，通过交错金属构件与氧化色彩，呈现工业美学与机械优雅，适用于建筑可视化、艺术装置或高端产品展示，营造精密光影变幻。
